title: 重力波干涉儀懸吊~Gravitational-wave interferometer suspensions
focus: 四級擺懸吊的隔振傳遞函數、熔融石英纖維熱雜訊與阻尼控制工程~Isolation transfer function of quadruple-pendulum suspensions, fused-silica fibre thermal noise and damping-control engineering
summary: 以 Advanced LIGO 的四級擺（40 kg 熔融石英測試質量、0.4 mm 石英纖維）與 Virgo 的超級衰減器為對象，從地面震動與 10⁻¹⁹ m 的位移目標出發，推導單擺 1/f² 與四級 1/f⁸ 的傳遞函數、擺動稀釋後的熱雜訊、葉片彈簧垂直隔振與致動層級，再整合局部阻尼、雜訊預算、真空安裝與鎖定取得，最後落到懸吊驗收與交接。~Using the Advanced LIGO quadruple pendulum (40 kg fused-silica test mass on 0.4 mm silica fibres) and the Virgo superattenuator as reference designs, the course starts from ground motion and the 10⁻¹⁹ m displacement target, derives the single-pendulum 1/f² and four-stage 1/f⁸ transfer functions, the dilution-reduced thermal noise, blade-spring vertical isolation and the actuation hierarchy, then integrates local damping, noise budgeting, in-vacuum installation and lock acquisition, ending with suspension acceptance and handoff.

units.anchor: 地面震動與測試質量~Ground motion and the test mass
units.title: 地震雜訊、應變目標與隔振需求~Seismic noise, strain target and the isolation requirement
units.mechanism: 重力波把 4 km 臂長改變 ΔL = h·L，h ≈ 10⁻²³ 時 ΔL 只有 4×10⁻²⁰ m；而安靜場址的地面在 10 Hz 仍以約 10⁻⁹ m/√Hz 的幅度晃動，兩者相差十個數量級。LIGO 把這個差距分給兩層：主動地震隔離平台用慣性感測器與致動器把送到懸吊頂端的運動壓到約 2×10⁻¹³ m，再由四級擺懸吊以被動方式再降近六個數量級，使測試質量在偵測頻帶內只對重力波與熱雜訊有反應。~A gravitational wave changes the 4 km arm by ΔL = h·L, only 4×10⁻²⁰ m for h ≈ 10⁻²³, while the ground at a quiet site still moves by about 10⁻⁹ m/√Hz at 10 Hz, ten orders of magnitude more. LIGO splits that gap across two layers: active seismic-isolation platforms with inertial sensors and actuators reduce the motion delivered to the top of the suspension to about 2×10⁻¹³ m, and the quadruple pendulum then passively removes nearly six more orders, so that in the detection band the test mass responds only to gravitational waves and thermal noise.
units.model: 需求：地面 10⁻⁹ m/√Hz（10 Hz）→ 測試質量 10⁻¹⁹ m/√Hz，總隔振 10¹⁰。平台負責約 10⁻⁹/2×10⁻¹³ ≈ 5×10³，懸吊負責 2×10⁻¹³/10⁻¹⁹ ≈ 2×10⁶。注意 4 km 兩端的鉛垂線夾角為 4000/6.371e6 = 6.3×10⁻⁴ rad，垂直運動以這個比例耦合進臂長方向，所以垂直隔振不能忽略。~Requirement: ground 10⁻⁹ m/√Hz at 10 Hz → test mass 10⁻¹⁹ m/√Hz, a total isolation of 10¹⁰. The platform supplies about 10⁻⁹/2×10⁻¹³ ≈ 5×10³ and the suspension 2×10⁻¹³/10⁻¹⁹ ≈ 2×10⁶. Note that the local verticals at the two ends of a 4 km arm differ by 4000/6.371e6 = 6.3×10⁻⁴ rad, so vertical motion couples into the arm direction at that ratio and vertical isolation cannot be neglected.
units.verify: 用地震儀量場址的地面位移譜，用平台上的慣性感測器量殘餘運動，兩者相除得到平台的實測隔振；把平台殘餘乘以懸吊模型傳遞函數預測測試質量位移，與干涉儀差動臂長（DARM）在 10–20 Hz 的實測雜訊比較，差額即為未建模的耦合。~Measure the site's ground displacement spectrum with seismometers and the residual motion with the platform's inertial sensors, their ratio being the achieved platform isolation; multiply the platform residual by the suspension model transfer function to predict test-mass displacement and compare with the measured differential arm-length (DARM) noise at 10–20 Hz, the shortfall being unmodelled coupling.
units.failure: 0.1–0.3 Hz 的海洋微震在風暴期間放大十倍，雖在偵測頻帶之外，卻讓致動器飽和、干涉儀無法維持鎖定；低估微震的隔振設計在冬季會損失大量觀測時間。~The 0.1–0.3 Hz ocean microseism grows tenfold during storms; although outside the detection band, it saturates the actuators and the interferometer cannot hold lock, so an isolation design that underestimates the microseism loses large amounts of winter observing time.
units.misconception: 只要把干涉儀建在夠安靜的地方，就不需要隔振系統。~Building the interferometer at a quiet enough site removes the need for isolation.

units.anchor: 單擺傳遞函數~Pendulum transfer function
units.title: 單擺低通濾波與多級擺鏈~The pendulum as a low-pass filter and multi-stage chains
units.mechanism: 單擺的懸點到擺錘的水平傳遞函數為 x_m/x_top = f₀²/(f₀² − f² + i·f·f₀/Q)，共振頻率 f₀ = (1/2π)√(g/l)；在 f ≫ f₀ 時以 (f₀/f)² 衰減，每級貢獻 1/f²，四級串接理想上給出 1/f⁸。代價是每一級都引入一個高 Q 的共振模態，必須在不注入感測器雜訊的前提下加以阻尼；Virgo 的超級衰減器更把倒立擺放在最上層，把起始共振壓到 0.03 Hz 量級。~A single pendulum's horizontal transfer function from suspension point to bob is x_m/x_top = f₀²/(f₀² − f² + i·f·f₀/Q) with resonance f₀ = (1/2π)√(g/l); for f ≫ f₀ it falls as (f₀/f)², each stage contributes 1/f² and four stages ideally give 1/f⁸. The price is a high-Q resonant mode per stage that must be damped without injecting sensor noise; the Virgo superattenuator goes further by placing an inverted pendulum at the top, pushing the first resonance down to the 0.03 Hz level.
units.model: l = 0.6 m：f₀ = (1/2π)√(9.81/0.6) = 0.64 Hz。單級在 10 Hz 的衰減 (0.64/10)² = 4.1×10⁻³，四級理想值 (4.1×10⁻³)⁴ ≈ 3×10⁻¹⁰。實測隔振通常只有 10⁻⁶ 到 10⁻⁸，因為葉片彈簧的垂直模態（f_v ≈ 2.5 Hz，四級給 (2.5/10)⁸ = 1.5×10⁻⁵）經由約 10⁻³ 的垂直–水平耦合進來，貢獻 1.5×10⁻⁸，遠大於水平路徑。~With l = 0.6 m, f₀ = (1/2π)√(9.81/0.6) = 0.64 Hz. One stage attenuates by (0.64/10)² = 4.1×10⁻³ at 10 Hz and four ideal stages by (4.1×10⁻³)⁴ ≈ 3×10⁻¹⁰. Measured isolation is usually 10⁻⁶ to 10⁻⁸, because the blade-spring vertical modes (f_v ≈ 2.5 Hz, four stages giving (2.5/10)⁸ = 1.5×10⁻⁵) enter through roughly 10⁻³ of vertical-to-horizontal coupling and contribute 1.5×10⁻⁸, far above the horizontal path.
units.verify: 以頂端致動器驅動掃頻或白雜訊，用各級的光學槓桿或影子感測器量測運動，得到逐級傳遞函數；與狀態空間模型比較模態頻率與 Q 值，模態頻率偏差應小於 5%；特別檢查 10 Hz 附近的實測衰減是否被垂直耦合支配。~Drive the top stage with swept-sine or white noise from its actuators and measure each stage's motion with optical levers or shadow sensors to obtain stage-by-stage transfer functions; compare mode frequencies and Q values with the state-space model, requiring frequency deviations under 5%; check in particular whether the measured attenuation near 10 Hz is dominated by vertical coupling.
units.failure: 鋼絲或石英纖維的小提琴模態（數百 Hz）與葉片彈簧內部模態 Q 值極高，若落在偵測頻帶內而未阻尼或未用陷波濾波處理，會在靈敏度曲線上留下一整排尖峰並在控制迴路中引發不穩定。~Violin modes of the wires or silica fibres (hundreds of hertz) and internal blade-spring modes have extremely high Q; if they fall inside the detection band without damping or notch filtering they leave a comb of sharp lines in the sensitivity curve and can destabilise the control loops.
units.misconception: 懸吊級數越多永遠越好，沒有代價。~More suspension stages are always better and come at no cost.

units.anchor: 熔融石英纖維與單體末級~Fused-silica fibres and the monolithic final stage
units.title: 熱雜訊、損耗角與擺動稀釋~Thermal noise, loss angle and pendulum dilution
units.mechanism: 依漲落–耗散定理，懸吊的熱雜訊由機械損耗角 φ 決定：鋼的 φ 約 10⁻³，熔融石英的本體 φ 可低到 10⁻⁷，所以 Advanced LIGO 的末級把 40 kg 石英測試質量以四根焊接的石英纖維吊起，形成單體結構。擺的回復力大部分來自無損耗的重力，只有纖維彎曲儲存的彈性能帶損耗，因此有效損耗角被「稀釋」為 φ_pend = φ_mat·D；纖維越細、張力越高，稀釋越強，但強度安全係數也越低，兩者必須一起設計。~By the fluctuation–dissipation theorem suspension thermal noise is set by the mechanical loss angle φ: steel has φ ≈ 10⁻³ while bulk fused silica reaches 10⁻⁷, so the Advanced LIGO final stage hangs the 40 kg silica test mass from four welded silica fibres as a monolithic assembly. Most of the pendulum's restoring force comes from lossless gravity and only the elastic energy stored in fibre bending is lossy, so the effective loss angle is diluted to φ_pend = φ_mat·D; thinner fibres under higher tension dilute more strongly but lower the strength safety factor, so the two are designed together.
units.model: 40 kg 由 4 根直徑 0.4 mm 的纖維分擔：每根張力 T = 98 N，截面 1.26×10⁻⁷ m²，應力 780 MPa。稀釋因子 D ≈ √(EI/T)/l：E = 72 GPa、I = πr⁴/4 = 1.26×10⁻¹⁵ m⁴、l = 0.6 m，D ≈ 9.6×10⁻⁴/0.6 = 1.6×10⁻³，φ_pend ≈ 1.6×10⁻¹⁰。10 Hz 的熱雜訊 x² = 4k_B·T·ω₀²·φ_pend/(m·ω⁵)，代入 m = 40 kg、ω₀ = 4.0 rad/s、ω = 62.8 rad/s，x ≈ 3.3×10⁻²⁰ m/√Hz，對 4 km 相當於 h ≈ 8×10⁻²⁴/√Hz。~40 kg shared by 4 fibres of 0.4 mm diameter: tension T = 98 N per fibre, cross-section 1.26×10⁻⁷ m², stress 780 MPa. Dilution factor D ≈ √(EI/T)/l with E = 72 GPa, I = πr⁴/4 = 1.26×10⁻¹⁵ m⁴ and l = 0.6 m gives D ≈ 9.6×10⁻⁴/0.6 = 1.6×10⁻³, so φ_pend ≈ 1.6×10⁻¹⁰. The thermal noise at 10 Hz, x² = 4k_B·T·ω₀²·φ_pend/(m·ω⁵) with m = 40 kg, ω₀ = 4.0 rad/s and ω = 62.8 rad/s, is x ≈ 3.3×10⁻²⁰ m/√Hz, equivalent to h ≈ 8×10⁻²⁴/√Hz over 4 km.
units.verify: 以雷射輪廓儀量纖維沿長度的直徑（±1%）並做比例負載的強度測試；用小提琴模態的振鈴衰減量 Q 值，目標在 10⁸ 以上；把量到的 φ 代入熱雜訊模型，與 DARM 在 10–50 Hz 的雜訊預算比較。~Profile the fibre diameter along its length with a laser profiler (±1%) and proof-test it at a proportional load; measure Q from the ring-down of the violin modes, targeting above 10⁸; insert the measured φ into the thermal-noise model and compare with the DARM noise budget between 10 and 50 Hz.
units.failure: 纖維表面的微裂或污染降低強度，在地震或搬運時斷裂，整個單體末級報廢；若退回鋼絲懸吊，熱雜訊上升約兩個數量級；焊接殘留應力則提高局部損耗，讓熱雜訊高於模型。~Surface microcracks or contamination lower the fibre strength and it breaks during an earthquake or transport, scrapping the whole monolithic stage; reverting to steel wires raises thermal noise by about two orders of magnitude, and residual weld stress raises local loss so that thermal noise exceeds the model.
units.misconception: 纖維越粗越安全，而且對雜訊沒有影響。~Thicker fibres are safer and have no effect on noise.

units.anchor: 葉片彈簧與致動層級~Blade springs and actuator hierarchy
units.title: 垂直隔振、葉片彈簧與致動層級~Vertical isolation, blade springs and the actuation hierarchy
units.mechanism: 每一級用預彎的馬氏體時效鋼三角形懸臂葉片提供垂直柔度，把垂直共振壓到 2–3 Hz；由於地球曲率與不對稱，垂直殘餘運動會以約 10⁻³ 的比例變成水平。致動依層級分配：頂端質量用線圈–磁鐵（OSEM）做大行程、毫米級的位置修正，倒數第二級用小線圈，測試質量只用靜電驅動施加奈牛頓級的力；反作用鏈與主鏈平行懸吊，使致動器不是推在震動的框架上。這種層級設計讓致動器的電子雜訊在測試質量上低於 10⁻²⁰ m/√Hz。~Each stage uses pre-curved triangular maraging-steel cantilever blades for vertical compliance, bringing the vertical resonances down to 2–3 Hz; through Earth curvature and asymmetries the residual vertical motion turns horizontal at about 10⁻³. Actuation is allocated by hierarchy: the top mass uses coil–magnet OSEMs for large, millimetre-scale corrections, the penultimate mass small coils, and the test mass only an electrostatic drive delivering nanonewton forces; a reaction chain hangs beside the main chain so the actuators do not push against a vibrating frame. This hierarchy keeps actuator electronics noise below 10⁻²⁰ m/√Hz at the test mass.
units.model: 垂直路徑：f_v = 2.5 Hz，單級在 10 Hz 衰減 (2.5/10)² = 0.0625，四級 1.5×10⁻⁵；若測試質量層級的垂直殘餘為 10⁻¹⁶ m/√Hz，乘上 6.3×10⁻⁴ 的曲率耦合即為 6.3×10⁻²⁰ m/√Hz，已達目標等級。靜電驅動：F = α·V_bias·V_sig，α = 2×10⁻¹⁰ N/V²、V_bias = 400 V 時每伏特 8×10⁻⁸ N，在 10 Hz 對 40 kg 的位移 x = F/(mω²) = 5×10⁻¹³ m/V；DAC 雜訊 10⁻⁷ V/√Hz 給 5×10⁻²⁰ m/√Hz。~Vertical path: f_v = 2.5 Hz, one stage attenuates (2.5/10)² = 0.0625 at 10 Hz and four stages 1.5×10⁻⁵; a vertical residual of 10⁻¹⁶ m/√Hz at the test-mass level times the 6.3×10⁻⁴ curvature coupling is 6.3×10⁻²⁰ m/√Hz, already at the target level. Electrostatic drive: F = α·V_bias·V_sig with α = 2×10⁻¹⁰ N/V² and V_bias = 400 V gives 8×10⁻⁸ N per volt, a displacement at 10 Hz on 40 kg of x = F/(mω²) = 5×10⁻¹³ m/V; DAC noise of 10⁻⁷ V/√Hz yields 5×10⁻²⁰ m/√Hz.
units.verify: 以葉片激振量垂直傳遞函數並比對模型；用干涉儀或光學槓桿校正每一層致動器的力／電壓常數；量測致動的交叉耦合矩陣（垂直→水平、傾斜→長度）；掃描靜電驅動偏壓，由力對偏壓的線性關係推算測試質量上的殘留電荷。~Excite the blades to measure the vertical transfer function and compare with the model; calibrate the force-per-volt constant of each actuation layer with the interferometer or an optical lever; measure the actuation cross-coupling matrix (vertical→horizontal, tilt→length); sweep the electrostatic-drive bias and infer residual charge on the test mass from the linearity of force versus bias.
units.failure: 測試質量累積電荷後，靜電驅動的力隨電荷變化而漂移並引入力雜訊；馬氏體時效鋼葉片在熱處理後仍會潛變，數月後懸吊高度與對準改變，致動器行程被吃掉。~Charge accumulating on the test mass makes the electrostatic-drive force drift with charge and injects force noise; maraging-steel blades keep creeping after heat treatment, so months later the suspension height and alignment have changed and actuator range is consumed.
units.misconception: 只需要隔離水平方向，因為干涉儀只量水平臂長。~Only horizontal isolation matters because the interferometer only measures horizontal arm length.

units.anchor: 影子感測器與阻尼迴路~Shadow sensors and damping loops
units.title: 局部阻尼、感測器雜訊與迴路設計~Local damping, sensor noise and loop design
units.mechanism: 擺的模態 Q 值可達 10⁵ 以上，一旦被擾動會振盪數小時，必須用頂端質量上的影子感測器與線圈做主動阻尼，把 Q 降到約 10。但感測器雜訊會隨迴路推回懸吊，雖然下面三級以約 1/f⁶ 衰減，在 10 Hz 仍可能高於熱雜訊，所以阻尼迴路必須在偵測頻帶內急遽滾降（低通與橢圓濾波器），只在共振頻率附近有增益。Virgo 則在倒立擺頂端以加速度計做慣性阻尼。~Pendulum modes with Q above 10⁵ ring for hours once disturbed, so shadow sensors and coils on the top mass provide active damping that brings Q to about 10. Sensor noise, however, is pushed back into the suspension by the loop; although the three lower stages attenuate it by roughly 1/f⁶, at 10 Hz it can still exceed thermal noise, so the damping loop must roll off steeply inside the detection band (low-pass and elliptic filters) and keep gain only around the resonances. Virgo instead damps inertially with accelerometers at the top of the inverted pendulum.
units.model: 影子感測器雜訊取 10⁻¹⁰ m/√Hz（10 Hz）。從頂端質量到測試質量三級的衰減 (0.64/10)⁶ = 7×10⁻⁸，若迴路在 10 Hz 增益為 1，注入的雜訊為 7×10⁻¹⁸ m/√Hz，比 10⁻¹⁹ 的目標高 70 倍；因此迴路在 10 Hz 的增益必須至少再降 40 dB（×0.01），注入量才降到 7×10⁻²⁰ m/√Hz。~Take shadow-sensor noise as 10⁻¹⁰ m/√Hz at 10 Hz. Three stages from top mass to test mass attenuate by (0.64/10)⁶ = 7×10⁻⁸, so with unity loop gain at 10 Hz the injected noise is 7×10⁻¹⁸ m/√Hz, 70 times the 10⁻¹⁹ target; the loop gain at 10 Hz must therefore be cut by at least a further 40 dB (×0.01) to bring the injection down to 7×10⁻²⁰ m/√Hz.
units.verify: 用掃頻量阻尼迴路的開迴路傳遞函數，確認相位裕度與偵測頻帶內的滾降；比較阻尼開／關時各模態的振鈴時間；做雜訊注入測試——把迴路增益提高 10 倍，觀察 DARM 在 10–30 Hz 是否變化，藉此推算正常增益下的注入量。~Measure the damping loop's open-loop transfer function with swept sine to confirm phase margin and the in-band roll-off; compare mode ring-down times with damping on and off; perform a noise-injection test by raising the loop gain tenfold and watching whether DARM changes between 10 and 30 Hz, from which the injection at normal gain is inferred.
units.failure: 阻尼增益過大時感測器雜訊進入頻帶，靈敏度在 10–30 Hz 被懸吊控制雜訊限制；增益過小則失鎖後擺動要幾十分鐘才平息，重新鎖定時間拉長。~Too much damping gain lets sensor noise into the band and sensitivity between 10 and 30 Hz becomes limited by suspension control noise; too little leaves the pendulum swinging for tens of minutes after a lock loss and stretches the relock time.
units.misconception: 阻尼越強越好，振盪越快停下來就越安全。~Stronger damping is always better because the oscillation stops sooner.

units.anchor: 懸吊雜訊預算表~Suspension noise-budget table
units.title: 雜訊預算與靈敏度曲線~Noise budget and the sensitivity curve
units.mechanism: 把殘餘地震、擺動熱雜訊、小提琴模態、垂直熱雜訊、致動器雜訊、感測器注入與牛頓雜訊各自寫成位移功率譜密度，以平方和開根號相加，再除以臂長 L 換成應變；與實測 DARM 比較就能看出哪一段頻率由懸吊支配（通常在 10–40 Hz）。預算表不是一次做完的文件，而是每次改動濾波器、換纖維或重新校正致動器後都要更新的工程工具。~Write residual seismic, pendulum thermal, violin-mode, vertical thermal, actuator, sensor-injection and Newtonian noise each as a displacement power spectral density, add them in quadrature and divide by the arm length L to convert to strain; comparing with the measured DARM shows where the suspension dominates, typically 10–40 Hz. The budget is not a one-off document but an engineering tool updated whenever a filter changes, a fibre is replaced or an actuator is recalibrated.
units.model: 在 20 Hz 取殘餘地震 1×10⁻¹⁹、懸吊熱雜訊 2×10⁻²⁰、致動器 1×10⁻²⁰ m/√Hz：總和 √(1×10⁻³⁸ + 4×10⁻⁴⁰ + 1×10⁻⁴⁰) = 1.02×10⁻¹⁹ m/√Hz，對 L = 4 km 為 h ≈ 2.6×10⁻²³/√Hz。地震項若再降 3 倍，總和降到約 4×10⁻²⁰，此時熱雜訊開始主導；數值為教學假設。~At 20 Hz take residual seismic 1×10⁻¹⁹, suspension thermal 2×10⁻²⁰ and actuator 1×10⁻²⁰ m/√Hz: the sum √(1×10⁻³⁸ + 4×10⁻⁴⁰ + 1×10⁻⁴⁰) = 1.02×10⁻¹⁹ m/√Hz, or h ≈ 2.6×10⁻²³/√Hz for L = 4 km. Reducing the seismic term by a further factor of 3 brings the total to about 4×10⁻²⁰, where thermal noise starts to dominate; values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 在試算表或雜訊預算軟體中建立各項並畫出曲線；以注入測試量化每一項（例如把阻尼增益提高 10 倍看 DARM 變化）；總預算與實測 DARM 的差距應小於 10–20%，否則表示有未建模的耦合（散射光、傾斜耦合）。~Build each term in a spreadsheet or noise-budget tool and plot the curves; quantify each term by injection tests (for example raising damping gain tenfold and watching DARM); the gap between the total budget and the measured DARM should be below 10–20%, otherwise an unmodelled coupling (scattered light, tilt coupling) is present.
units.failure: 懸吊籠架或擋板運動造成的散射光耦合是非線性、非平穩的，在低頻製造「肩狀」雜訊並常被誤判為地震殘餘；只用線性預算表永遠對不上實測曲線。~Scattered-light coupling from motion of the suspension cage or baffles is nonlinear and non-stationary, producing shoulder-shaped noise at low frequency that is often misread as seismic residual; a purely linear budget never matches the measured curve.
units.misconception: 總雜訊就是各項雜訊的線性相加。~Total noise is the linear sum of the individual terms.

units.anchor: 真空腔安裝與鎖定取得~Vacuum-chamber installation and lock acquisition
units.title: 真空整合、潔淨裝配與鎖定取得~Vacuum integration, clean assembly and lock acquisition
units.mechanism: 懸吊在潔淨室組裝後整組吊入真空腔，腔內壓力約 10⁻⁹ mbar 等級，纖維在搬運與抽氣期間必須加裝保護；抽真空後模態頻率與對準要重新確認，因為空氣阻尼消失、Q 值上升。鎖定取得依賴致動層級把臂腔推到共振：臂腔線寬只有奈米級，測試質量通過共振時的速度必須夠慢，否則來不及建立控制訊號，所以阻尼後的殘餘速度是懸吊交給鎖定系統的關鍵規格。~After cleanroom assembly the whole suspension is lifted into a vacuum chamber held near 10⁻⁹ mbar, with fibre guards fitted during transport and pump-down; after evacuation mode frequencies and alignment are re-verified because air damping disappears and Q rises. Lock acquisition relies on the actuation hierarchy to bring the arm cavity onto resonance: the cavity linewidth is only nanometres, and the test mass must cross resonance slowly enough for the control signal to build up, so the damped residual velocity is the key specification the suspension hands to the locking system.
units.model: 臂腔：L = 4 km、精細度 F = 450，自由光譜範圍 c/2L = 37.5 kHz，線寬 37.5 kHz/450 = 83 Hz，換成長度 δL = λ/(2F) = 1064 nm/900 = 1.2 nm；光儲存時間 τ_s = F·L/(πc) = 1.9 ms，可捕捉的鏡速 v ≲ δL/τ_s ≈ 0.6 µm/s。而 0.15 Hz、振幅 1 µm 的微震給出 v = 2π×0.15×1 µm ≈ 0.9 µm/s，已超過，因此必須靠平台的感測器修正把微震壓下。~Arm cavity: L = 4 km, finesse F = 450, free spectral range c/2L = 37.5 kHz, linewidth 37.5 kHz/450 = 83 Hz, in length δL = λ/(2F) = 1064 nm/900 = 1.2 nm; the storage time τ_s = F·L/(πc) = 1.9 ms sets a catchable mirror velocity v ≲ δL/τ_s ≈ 0.6 µm/s. A microseism at 0.15 Hz with 1 µm amplitude gives v = 2π×0.15×1 µm ≈ 0.9 µm/s, already too fast, so the platform's sensor correction must suppress the microseism.
units.verify: 抽氣後做壓升率測試估算出氣率；比較真空中與空氣中的模態頻率與 Q；統計鎖定取得時間與成功率對微震幅度的關係；用光學槓桿確認整條鏈的對準範圍足以覆蓋安裝誤差。~After pump-down run a rate-of-rise test to estimate outgassing; compare mode frequencies and Q in vacuum with those in air; log lock-acquisition time and success rate against microseism amplitude; confirm with optical levers that the alignment range of the whole chain covers the installation errors.
units.failure: 地震或搬運使纖維斷裂，整個真空腔必須開腔更換末級；石英纖維在受力下接觸水氣會發生應力腐蝕而緩慢裂開，所以安裝期間的濕度暴露會縮短壽命；測試質量上的微粒污染則增加散射損耗。~An earthquake or transport breaks a fibre and the chamber must be opened to replace the final stage; stressed silica fibres exposed to humidity undergo stress corrosion and crack slowly, so humidity exposure during installation shortens their life; particulate contamination on the test mass adds scatter loss.
units.misconception: 鎖定失敗是光學問題，與懸吊無關。~Lock failures are optical problems unrelated to the suspensions.

units.anchor: 懸吊驗收與交接紀錄~Suspension acceptance and handoff record
units.title: 懸吊驗收、模型校正與工程交接~Suspension acceptance, model fitting and engineering handoff
units.mechanism: 驗收要逐項比對：所有模態頻率與模型的偏差、Q 值、逐級傳遞函數、阻尼後的安定時間、各層致動器校正常數、纖維的輪廓與強度紀錄、熱雜訊估計值。交接文件包含竣工圖、濾波器設定、感測器校正常數與控制系統中的狀態空間模型；交接後仍要長期監測對準漂移、葉片潛變與電荷累積，因為這些慢變量會在數月後改變控制器所依據的受控體。~Acceptance compares item by item: deviation of every mode frequency from the model, Q values, stage-by-stage transfer functions, settling time after damping, calibration constants of each actuation layer, fibre profile and strength records and the thermal-noise estimate. The handoff record holds as-built drawings, filter settings, sensor calibration constants and the state-space model loaded in the control system; after handoff, alignment drift, blade creep and charge build-up are monitored long term because these slow variables change the plant the controllers were designed for months later.
units.model: 模態檢查：模型 0.643 Hz、實測 0.650 Hz，偏差 1.1%（接受門檻 5%）。阻尼後 Q = 10 的振鈴時間 τ = Q/(πf₀) = 10/(π×0.643) ≈ 5 s；未阻尼 Q = 10⁵ 時約 14 小時。若頂端葉片每月潛變下沉 10 µm，一年累積 120 µm，占去 ±1 mm 致動行程的 12%，必須排程重新置中。~Mode check: model 0.643 Hz, measured 0.650 Hz, deviation 1.1% (acceptance threshold 5%). With damping to Q = 10 the ring-down time τ = Q/(πf₀) = 10/(π×0.643) ≈ 5 s; undamped at Q = 10⁵ it is about 14 hours. If the top blades creep 10 µm per month, a year accumulates 120 µm, 12% of the ±1 mm actuator range, so re-centring must be scheduled.
units.verify: 執行最終測試矩陣：模態表比對、安定時間 < 10 s、致動器校正與干涉儀的光子校正器交叉比對；彙整成驗收紀錄並附上回歸測試腳本，任何濾波器或硬體變更後重跑並記錄差異。~Run the final test matrix: mode-table comparison, settling time under 10 s, actuator calibration cross-checked against the interferometer's photon calibrator; compile the acceptance record with regression scripts, rerun after any filter or hardware change and log the differences.
units.failure: 模型與實測的差異未記錄，控制濾波器依錯誤的受控體設計，數月後在某個模態附近出現不穩定；或潛變未被追蹤，致動器行程用盡後懸吊無法再對準。~Undocumented model-versus-measurement discrepancies lead to control filters designed on the wrong plant and an instability near some mode months later; or untracked creep exhausts the actuator range and the suspension can no longer be aligned.
units.misconception: 懸吊安裝完成後就不再需要維護與重新校正。~Once installed, a suspension needs no maintenance or recalibration.

example: 懸吊熱雜訊與隔振練習：40 kg 測試質量由 4 根直徑 0.4 mm、長 0.6 m 的熔融石英纖維吊起。每根張力 98 N，截面 1.26×10⁻⁷ m²，應力 780 MPa。E = 72 GPa、I = πr⁴/4 = 1.26×10⁻¹⁵ m⁴，稀釋因子 D ≈ √(EI/T)/l = 9.6×10⁻⁴/0.6 = 1.6×10⁻³；取材料損耗 φ_mat = 10⁻⁷，φ_pend = 1.6×10⁻¹⁰。f₀ = (1/2π)√(9.81/0.6) = 0.64 Hz，ω₀ = 4.0 rad/s。10 Hz 的熱雜訊 x² = 4k_B·T·ω₀²·φ_pend/(m·ω⁵) = 4×1.38×10⁻²³×293×16×1.6×10⁻¹⁰/(40×62.8⁵) ≈ 1.1×10⁻³⁹ m²/Hz，x ≈ 3.3×10⁻²⁰ m/√Hz，對 4 km 臂長 h ≈ 8×10⁻²⁴/√Hz。隔振：單級 10 Hz 衰減 (0.64/10)² = 4.1×10⁻³，四級理想 3×10⁻¹⁰；垂直路徑 (2.5/10)⁸×10⁻³ = 1.5×10⁻⁸ 反而主導，所以垂直隔振才是真正的瓶頸。數值為教學假設，不代表任何實機規格。~Suspension thermal-noise and isolation exercise: a 40 kg test mass hangs from 4 fused-silica fibres of 0.4 mm diameter and 0.6 m length. Each carries 98 N over 1.26×10⁻⁷ m², a stress of 780 MPa. With E = 72 GPa and I = πr⁴/4 = 1.26×10⁻¹⁵ m⁴ the dilution factor D ≈ √(EI/T)/l = 9.6×10⁻⁴/0.6 = 1.6×10⁻³; taking a material loss φ_mat = 10⁻⁷ gives φ_pend = 1.6×10⁻¹⁰. f₀ = (1/2π)√(9.81/0.6) = 0.64 Hz, ω₀ = 4.0 rad/s. The thermal noise at 10 Hz, x² = 4k_B·T·ω₀²·φ_pend/(m·ω⁵) = 4×1.38×10⁻²³×293×16×1.6×10⁻¹⁰/(40×62.8⁵) ≈ 1.1×10⁻³⁹ m²/Hz, gives x ≈ 3.3×10⁻²⁰ m/√Hz, or h ≈ 8×10⁻²⁴/√Hz over a 4 km arm. Isolation: one stage attenuates (0.64/10)² = 4.1×10⁻³ at 10 Hz and four ideal stages 3×10⁻¹⁰, but the vertical path (2.5/10)⁸×10⁻³ = 1.5×10⁻⁸ dominates, so vertical isolation is the real bottleneck. Values are teaching assumptions, not any detector's specification.
history: 1970 年代 Weiss、Drever 等人提出雷射干涉重力波偵測並建造原型，懸吊從單級鋼絲擺開始；格拉斯哥大學在 1990–2000 年代為 GEO600 發展出焊接熔融石英的單體懸吊，證明熱雜訊可以大幅降低，這項技術由英國團隊（格拉斯哥、伯明翰、盧瑟福實驗室）放大成 Advanced LIGO 的四級擺，於 2015 年首次偵測 GW150914。Virgo 由比薩的 INFN 團隊自 1990 年代發展倒立擺加多級濾波器的超級衰減器，而 KAGRA 則把藍寶石測試質量冷卻到 20 K 以進一步壓低熱雜訊。~In the 1970s Weiss, Drever and others proposed laser-interferometric gravitational-wave detection and built prototypes whose suspensions began as single-stage steel-wire pendulums; the University of Glasgow developed welded fused-silica monolithic suspensions for GEO600 in the 1990s and 2000s, showing that thermal noise could be cut dramatically, and the UK team (Glasgow, Birmingham, Rutherford Appleton Laboratory) scaled the technique into the Advanced LIGO quadruple pendulum that made the first detection, GW150914, in 2015. Virgo's superattenuator of an inverted pendulum plus a chain of mechanical filters was developed by the INFN team in Pisa from the 1990s, and KAGRA cools sapphire test masses to 20 K to push thermal noise lower still.
